description.zh: 空间使用的应用名称，默认取值：live
description.en: Application name used by the workspace. Default value: live

description.zh: 空间内设备/流状态更新时的回调
description.en: Callback URL triggered when device or stream status updates in the workspace

description.zh:

Ingest protocol used by the workspace. Valid values:

- gb28181

- rtmp

是否启用按需拉流。取值：

- true

Whether to enable on-demand stream pulling. Valid values:

- false (default)

- true

description.zh:
空间使用的播放协议，多值用逗号分隔，取值：
- flv
- hls
- rtmp
description.en:
Playback protocols used by the workspace. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values:

- flv

- hls

- rtmp
